newsitem.title: USA: Station Casinos to issue $150 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Station Casinos to issue $150 mln in debt.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc on Wednesday said it will sell $150 million in 10-year senior subordinated notes via sole manager BancAmerica Securities.
The deal will be priced in the 144A private placement market no later than Monday, March 31, according to a high-yield market source.
The notes are rated B2 by Moody's Investors Service and B-plus by Standard & Poor's.
Proceeds from the deal will be used to pay down amounts outstanding under the company's $372 million bank facility, Station said.

The availability under the bank facility, cash flows from operations, and equipment financing will be used to pay the remaining construction costs for the next phase of the Station Casino St. Charles master plan of approximately $132 million, the company said.
The facility will also be used to provide additional equity contributions for the completion of Sunset Station, for payment of construction payables and general corporate purposes, it added.
